title: Whaling with a deepfake
brief: 17:40. Helen Marsh, the CEO, calls you on Meet. You can see her face and hear her voice. She needs a payment made tonight.
insight: A face and a voice can both be generated from a few minutes of public video. Seeing is no longer proof.
teaches: The call back rule: end the call, and call the person on a number you already hold
Spot the tells: a stiff face, a mouth out of time, excuses not to move or turn
No call, however senior, skips the payment approval process

script.say: Sam, thank you for joining at short notice. I will be quick, the signal here is terrible.
We are completing the {{deal}} deal tonight. The escrow deposit of {{amt.s}} pounds has to leave before the run closes. Dan has signed it off, and I have put the payment in Finance for you.

choices.label: Of course, I will release it now
It needs Dan's approval in the ERP. I cannot skip that.
Before anything, could you turn your head for me, or wave?
I will call your office back to confirm

script.say: Thank you. And please keep this to yourself until it is announced.
Dan is with the lawyers, he cannot log in. I am authorising it myself. Just release it, Sam.

choices.label: Sorry, it goes through approval or not at all
I will call your office to confirm

script.say: The camera keeps freezing, I cannot. We do not have time for this.

choices.label: Then it waits for Dan's approval
I will call your office and come back to you

script.say: Fine. I will have Dan call you.

value.note: Added tonight at the CEO's request on a call. No vendor record. Not approved by Dan.

choices.label: Is Helen on a Meet call asking me to release an escrow payment?

script.say: No. Helen is at a board dinner and her phone is off. Nothing about escrow has been sent to finance. Please do not pay anything, and report it.

setup.title: Meet
setup.body: Helen Marsh is calling you on Meet

outcome.label: Asked for a live test
outcome.what: A real person can turn their head. A generated face tends to glitch, freeze, or find an excuse.
outcome.ideal: asks for something a fake struggles with, but still verifies elsewhere.

outcome.label: Would not skip the approval
outcome.what: Rank does not skip the process. The payment still needs Dan and a verified beneficiary.
outcome.ideal: keeps to the payment process on any call.

outcome.label: Called the CEO's office back
outcome.what: Helen is at a board dinner with her phone off. The face on Meet was generated.
outcome.ideal: hangs up and calls back on a number they already hold.

outcome.label: Reported the call
outcome.what: Security needs to know someone can fake Helen live.
outcome.ideal: reports a deepfake so others are warned.

outcome.label: Agreed to release it on the call
outcome.what: A face on a screen asked, and you said yes. That is exactly the moment the call is designed for.
outcome.ideal: never agrees to move money on a call.

decide.objective: Join the call, then decide what happens to the escrow payment (P-ESCROW in Finance).
decide.insight: Look at the tile: the face barely moves and the mouth is out of time. Then remember that even a perfect face would prove nothing.

hint.text: Join the Meet call. Do not agree to the payment. Leave, call Helen's office on 4001 from the desk phone, then hold P-ESCROW in Finance and report the call.

outcome.label: Released the escrow payment
outcome.what: £{{amt.s}} left for an account the attacker controls, on the strength of a face on a screen.
outcome.ideal: never releases a payment that skipped approval, whoever asked on a call.

card.title: The face was generated
body: Helen was at a board dinner with her phone off. The face and voice on Meet were generated from her conference talks online.

The tells were there: a stiff face, a mouth out of time, excuses not to turn her head, an outside meeting link. But the rule does not need tells: hang up, call back on a number you hold, and let the approval process decide.
card.ideal: uses the call back rule and keeps to the approval process.

outcome.label: Held the escrow payment
outcome.what: Nothing moves without Dan's approval and a verified beneficiary, and neither is coming.
outcome.ideal: holds a payment that arrived by call until it is properly approved.

card.title: Seeing was not believing
body: You held the payment. The call came from an outside link, the face barely moved, and she could not turn her head. Helen's office confirmed she was never on it.
A convincing face and voice can now be made from public video. The defence is not a sharper eye: it is the call back and the approval process.
card.ideal: hangs up, calls back on a known number, and keeps to the process.

auto.text: Report the call so security knows Helen is being faked.

hint.text: Raise a Helpdesk ticket (suspicious call), or report the meeting from Meet.
